successors.name: Anau culture
successors.text: the Turkmen side of the Kopet Dag piedmont, the Anau country

ledger.x: 6000 BCE: the Jeitun farmers hold the Kopet Dag piedmont from Shahrud to the Tedjen ("occupied from about 7200 to 4500 BC"; "may have begun prior to 7000 BC").
4500 BCE: the Iranian side of the Kopet Dag is left to nobody: the pages name no successor there (the Anau culture is "centred in southern Turkmenistan").
4500 BCE: the Jeitun settlement ends ("occupied from about 7200 to 4500 BC") and "Jeitun period of Turkmenistan was followed by the Anau culture".

certainty.note: Known from scattered village sites; no frontier is recorded.
